Bihar BTSC ECG Technician Final Result 2026

Post Date: July 17, 2026

10:48 am

Bihar Technical Service Commission (BTSC), has released the Final Result on the official website for the Lab Technician, OT Assistant, ECG Technician, X-Ray Technician & Specialist Medical Officer (SMO) Examination 2025. The exam was conducted on 26th April 2025, and the last date to submit the application form was 01 April 2024. Candidates can check their Final Result using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.
